# X-ray

Turns a surface into a see-through shell of light, brightest at its edges, that shows through whatever is in front of it. It can draw everywhere, or only where the object is hidden, for spotting players behind walls.

<EffectDemo effect="x-ray" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { xRay } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/x-ray';

const effect = xRay({ preset: 'scanner' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#66e0ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the materials the effect is patched into.

## Parameters

| Parameter                  | Type                                                      | Default     | Range    | Description                                                          |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`                    | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#66e0ff'` |          | Color of the shell.                                                  |
| `intensity`                | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0 – 8    | Brightness, in linear units.                                         |
| `edgePower`                | number                                                    | `2`         | 0.25 – 8 | How tightly the light hugs the edges.                                |
| `fill`                     | number                                                    | `0.08`      | 0 – 1    | Light across the faces toward the camera.                            |
| `occlusion` _(structural)_ | 'always' \| 'hidden'                                      | `'always'`  |          | Draw over everything, or only the parts hidden behind other objects. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                           |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `scanner` | `color: '#8dff9a'`, `edgePower: 1.5`, `fill: 0.15` |
| `hidden`  | `occlusion: 'hidden'`, `intensity: 2`              |
| `ghost`   | `color: '#d0c4ff'`, `intensity: 0.8`, `fill: 0.25` |

Apply one with `xRay({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/x-ray`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Fresnel-weighted additive shell with a reversed depth test for hidden parts.
